purpose: City-specific cadastral-source research; findings are limited to observed first-party evidence.
name: Rantau Prapat

queries.query: Rantau Prapat cadastral parcel map official Indonesia
queries.result: Official Indonesian sources identified the ATR/BPN BHUMI map, ATLAS geospatial portal, and the Labuhan Batu land-office group. No Rantau Prapat-specific public parcel layer or safe parcel response was verified.

queries.query: Rantau Prapat peta bidang tanah pertanahan resmi
queries.result: Search identified official ATR/BPN BHUMI/ATLAS documentation and the national open land-map procedure. Results did not expose a Rantau Prapat/Labuhan Batu parcel dataset with a public native ID and geometry endpoint.

officialSources.observation: Official ATR/BPN public map platform; its documentation describes open land-parcel visualization, but no Rantau Prapat parcel response was obtained.
Official ATR/BPN ATLAS catalog. The public resource API returned seven general datasets; none was a Labuhan Batu/Rantau Prapat parcel layer.
Identifies the local custodian as Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Labuhanbatu, at Rantauprapat; this is custodian evidence, not evidence of an open parcel service.

requestOutcomes.outcome: 200 HTML shell requiring JavaScript. The current script was inspected; it configures https://tanahair.indonesia.go.id/v3/ and https://tanahair.indonesia.go.id/api-inageo/.
200 JSON welcome response; no parcel route or city-specific dataset was exposed.
404 Not Found; no endpoint inferred beyond the current JavaScript configuration.
200 JSON with 7 public resources; none covered Rantau Prapat or Labuhan Batu parcels.
200 JSON; a group named Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Labuhan Batu was present with resource_count 0.
403 Forbidden; no retry with credentials, bypass, or TLS exception.
403 Forbidden; no schema, CRS, parcel ID, or geometry response obtained.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official national ATR/BPN public map/catalog routes and the identified Labuhan Batu land-office catalog group were checked.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No Rantau Prapat parcel response, native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was verified.

remainingUncertainty: A zero catalog result, 403 service response, or unavailable viewer route does not prove citywide cadastral absence. The exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted. No login, credential, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, unsafe field request, or TLS-disabling exception was used. No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity and polygon were observed. This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or admission.
